H6000.def: the same as «05999»; Amal, an Israelite:--Amal.

H6001.def: from «05998»; toiling; concretely, a laborer; figuratively, sorrowful:--that laboureth, that is a misery, had taken (labour), wicked, workman.

H6002.def: probably of foreign origin; Amalek, a descendant of Esau; also his posterity and their country:--Amalek.

H6003.def: patronymically from «06002»; an Amalekite (or collectively the Amalekites) or descendants of Amalek: --Amalekite(-s).

H6004.def: a primitive root; to associate; by implication, to overshadow (by huddling together):--become dim, hide.

H6005.et: from (05973) and (0410) with a pronominal suffix inserted
H6005.def: from «05973» and «0410» with a pronominal suffix inserted; with us (is) God; Immanuel, a type name of Isaiah's son:--Immanuel.

H6006.def: or mamas {aw-mas'}; a primitive root; to load, i.e. impose a burden (or figuratively, infliction):--be borne, (heavy) burden (self), lade, load, put.

H6007.def: from «06006» and «03050»; Jah has loaded; Amasjah, an Israelite:--Amasiah.

H6008.def: from «05971» and «05703»; people of time; Amad, a place in Palestine:--Amad.

H6009.def: a primitive root; to be (causatively, make) deep (literally or figuratively):--(be, have, make, seek) deep(-ly), depth, be profound.

H6010.def: from «06009»; a vale (i.e. broad depression):--dale, vale, valley (often used as a part of proper names). See also «01025».

H6012.def: from «06009»; deep (literally or figuratively):--deeper, depth, strange.

H6013.def: from «06009»; deep (literally or figuratively):--(X exceeding) deep (thing).

H6014.def: a primitive root; properly, apparently to heap; figuratively, to chastise (as if piling blows); specifically (as denominative from «06016») to gather grain:--bind sheaves, make merchandise of.

H6016.def: from «06014»; properly, a heap, i.e. a sheaf; also an omer, as a dry measure:--omer, sheaf.

H6017.def: from «06014»; a (ruined) heap; Amorah, a place in Palestine:--Gomorrah.

H6019.def: probably from «05971» and «07311»; high people; Amram, the name of two Israelites:--Amram.

H6020.def: from «06019»; an Amramite or descendant of Amram:--Amramite.

H6021.def: from «06006»; burden; Amasa, the name of two Israelites:--Amasa.

H6022.def: from «06006»; burdensome; Amasai, the name of three Israelites:--Amasai.

H6023.def: probably from «06006»; burdensome; Amashsay, an Israelite:--Amashai.

H6024.def: from the same as «06025»; fruit; Anab, a place in Palestine:--Anab.

H6025.et: from an unused root probably meaning to bear fruit
H6025.def: from an unused root probably meaning to bear fruit; a grape:--(ripe) grape, wine.

H6026.def: a primitive root; to be soft or pliable, i.e. (figuratively) effeminate or luxurious:--delicate(-ness), (have) delight (self), sport self.

H6029.def: a primitive root; to lace fast:--bind, tie.

H6030.def: a primitive root; properly, to eye or (generally) to heed, i.e. pay attention; by implication, to respond; by extens. to begin to speak; specifically to sing, shout, testify, announce:--give account, afflict (by mistake for «06031»), (cause to, give) answer, bring low (by mistake for «06031»), cry, hear, Leannoth, lift up, say, × scholar, (give a) shout, sing (together by course), speak, testify, utter, (bear) witness. See also «01042», «01043».

H6031.et: a primitive root [possibly rather ident. with (06030) through the idea of looking down or browbeating]
H6031.def: a primitive root (possibly rather ident. with «06030» through the idea of looking down or browbeating); to depress literally or figuratively, transitive or intransitive (in various applications, as follows):--abase self, afflict(-ion, self), answer (by mistake for «06030»), chasten self, deal hardly with, defile, exercise, force, gentleness, humble (self), hurt, ravish, sing (by mistake for «06030»), speak (by mistake for «06030»), submit self, weaken, × in any wise.

H6034.def: probably from «06030»; an answer; Anah, the name of two Edomites and one Edomitess:--Anah.

H6035.def: or (by intermixture with «06041») Aanayv {aw-nawv'}; from «06031»; depressed (figuratively), in mind (gentle) or circumstances (needy, especially saintly):--humble, lowly, meek, poor. Compare «06041».

H6036.et: pass. part. from the same as (06025)
H6036.def: passive participle from the same as «06025»; borne (as fruit); Anub, an Israelite:--Anub.

H6037.def: feminine of «06035»; mildness (royal); also (concretely) oppressed:--gentleness, meekness.

H6038.def: from «06035»; condescension, human and subjective (modesty), or divine and objective (clemency):--gentleness, humility, meekness.

H6041.def: from «06031»; depressed, in mind or circumstances (practically the same as «06035», although the margin constantly disputes this, making «06035» subjective and «06041» objective):--afflicted, humble, lowly, needy, poor.

H6042.def: from «06031»; afflicted; Unni, the name of two Israelites:--Unni.

H6043.def: from «06030»; Jah has answered; Anajah, the name of two Israelites:--Anaiah.

H6044.def: for plural of «05869»; fountains; Anim, a place in Palestine:--Anim.

H6045.def: from «06031»; ado, i.e. (generally) employment or (specifically) an affair:--business, travail.

H6046.def: from the dual of «05869»; two fountains; Anem, a place in Palestine: Anem.

H6047.et: as if pl. of some Egyptian word
H6047.def: as if plural of some Egyptian word; Anamim, a son of Mizraim and his descendants, with their country:--Anamim.

H6048.def: of foreign origin; Anammelek, an Assyrian deity:--Anammelech.

H6049.def: a primitive root; to cover; used only as a denominative from «06051», to cloud over; figuratively, to act covertly, i.e. practise magic:--X bring, enchanter, Meonemin, observe(-r of) times, soothsayer, sorcerer.

H6051.def: from «06049»; a cloud (as covering the sky), i.e. the nimbus or thunder-cloud:--cloud(-y).

H6052.def: the same as «06051»; cloud; Anan, an Israelite:--Anan.

H6055.def: from «06049» and «03050»; Jah has covered; Ananjah, the name of an Israelite and of a place in Palestine:--Ananiah.

H6057.et: from an unused root meaning to cover
H6057.def: from an unused root meaning to cover; a twig (as covering the limbs):--bough, branch.

H6058.def: from the same as «06057»; branching:--full of branches.

H6059.def: a primitive root; properly, to choke; used only as denominative from «06060», to collar, i.e. adorn with a necklace; figuratively, to fit out with supplies:--compass about as a chain, furnish, liberally.

H6061.def: the same as «06060»; Anak, a Canaanite:--Anak.

H6062.def: patronymically from «06061»; an Anakite or descendant of Anak:--Anakim.

H6063.def: probably for «05288»; Aner, a Amorite, also a place in Palestine:--Aner.

H6064.def: a primitive root; properly, to urge; by implication, to inflict a penalty, specifically, to fine:--amerce, condemn, punish, × surely.

H6068.def: plural of «06067»; Anathoth, the name of two Israelites, also of a place in Pal:--Anathoth.

H6069.def: or rAnnthowthiy {an-ne-tho-thee'}; patrial from «06068»; a Antothite or inhabitant of Anathoth:--of Anathoth, Anethothite, Anetothite, Antothite.

H6070.def: from the same as «06068» and «03050»; answers of Jah; Anthothijah, an Israelite:--Antothijah.

H6071.def: from «06072»; must or fresh grape-juice (as just trodden out):--juice, new (sweet) wine.

H6072.def: a primitive root; to squeeze out juice; figuratively, to trample:--tread down.

H6073.et: from an unused root meaning to cover
H6073.def: from an unused root meaning to cover; a bough (as covering the tree):--branch.

H6074.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to «06073»; a twig; bough, i.e. (collectively) foliage:--leaves.

H6075.def: a primitive root; to swell; figuratively, be elated:--be lifted up, presume.

H6076.def: from «06075»; a tumor; also a mound, i.e. fortress:--emerod, fort, strong hold, tower.

H6077.def: the same as «06076»; Ophel, a ridge in Jerusalem:--Ophel.

H6078.et: from an unused noun [denoting a place in Palestine]
H6078.def: from an unused noun (denoting a place in Palestine; from an unused root of uncertain meaning); an Ophnite (collectively) or inhabitants of Ophen:--Ophni.

H6079.def: from «05774»; an eyelash (as fluttering); figuratively, morning ray:--dawning, eye-lid.

H6080.et: a primitive root: meaning either to be gray or perhaps rather to pulverise; used only as denominative from (06083), to be dust
H6080.def: : a primitive root: meaning either to be gray or perhaps rather to pulverize; used only as denominative from «06083», to be dust:--cast (dust).

H6081.def: probably a variation of «06082»; gazelle; Epher, the name of an Arabian and of two Israelites:--Epher.

H6082.def: from «06080»; a fawn (from the dusty color):--young roe (hart).

H6083.def: from «06080»; dust (as powdered or gray); hence, clay, earth, mud:--ashes, dust, earth, ground, morter, powder, rubbish.

H6084.def: feminine of «06082»; female fawn; Ophrah, the name of an Israelite and of two places in Palestine:--Ophrah.

H6085.def: from the same as «06081»; fawn-like; Ephron, the name of a Canaanite and of two places in Palestine:--Ephron, Ephrain (from the margin).

H6086.def: from «06095»; a tree (from its firmness); hence, wood (plural sticks):--+ carpenter, gallows, helve, + pine, plank, staff, stalk, stick, stock, timber, tree, wood.

H6087.def: a primitive root; properly, to carve, i.e. fabricate or fashion; hence (in a bad sense) to worry, pain or anger:-- displease, grieve, hurt, make, be sorry, vex, worship, wrest.

H6089.def: from «06087»; an earthen vessel; usually (painful) toil; also a pang (whether of body or mind): grievous, idol, labor, sorrow.

H6090.def: a variation of «06089»; an idol (as fashioned); also pain (bodily or mental):--idol, sorrow, × wicked.

H6093.def: from «06087»; worrisomeness, i.e. labor or pain:--sorrow, toil.

H6094.def: from «06087»; a idol; also, a pain or wound:--sorrow, wound.

H6095.def: a primitive root; properly, to fasten (or make firm), i.e. to close (the eyes):--shut.

H6096.def: from «06095»; the spine (as giving firmness to the body):--backbone.

H6098.def: from «03289»; advice; by implication, plan; also prudence:--advice, advisement, counsel(l-(or)), purpose.

H6099.def: or matsum {aw-tsoom'}; passive participle of «06105»; powerful (specifically, a paw); by implication, numerous:--+ feeble, great, mighty, must, strong.
